download_mechanism: get_dataset.sh wget's http(s)://gvv.mpi-inf.mpg.de/3dhp-dataset/S<subject>/Seq<seq>/{annot.mat,camera.calibration,imageSequence/*.zip}; no registration/credentials required. Only annot.mat + camera.calibration were fetched (direct 2D+3D ground truth; imageSequence video was not needed for GT-based training/eval).
repo_storage_format: Each annot.mat (94-206MB) exceeds GitHub's 100MB per-file limit, so it is committed as <=90MB annot.mat.part-NN chunks (plain git objects, no Git LFS) and reassembled on demand by scripts/training/reassemble_mpi_inf_3dhp.sh, which verifies the rebuilt file's SHA-256 against annotation_sha256 below. camera.calibration is small enough to commit directly.

citation: Mehta, D. et al. VNect: Real-time 3D Human Pose Estimation With A Single RGB Camera, ACM ToG (SIGGRAPH) 2017

coordinate_and_schema_provenance.source_camera_axes: +X right, +Y down, +Z forward, millimetres (per official README.txt / mpi3dhp_adapter.py)
coordinate_and_schema_provenance.conversion: src/pose/mpi3dhp_adapter.py:load_mpi3dhp_ground_truth — column swap (x, z, -y) * 0.001, then subtract joint 14 (pelvis) position
coordinate_and_schema_provenance.canonical_joint_subset: 17-joint H36M-compatible subset via fixed index list _JOINTS_17 in mpi3dhp_adapter.py
coordinate_and_schema_provenance.landmark_confidence: GT import sets confidence=1.0 / visible=True for all joints (no source occlusion flag consumed) — this is dataset ground truth, not a detector output; see docs/08 Candidate B framing.
coordinate_and_schema_provenance.camera_selection: camera_index 0 only (mpii_get_camera_set.m 'vnect' set is [0,1,2,4,5,6,7,8]; this run uses camera 0 for both train and holdout, matching docs/06's worked example)
coordinate_and_schema_provenance.fps: Not read from mpii_get_sequence_info.m per-sequence table (25 or 50 fps depending on subject/sequence); src/pose/mpi3dhp_adapter.py defaults fps=25.0 for all imports since the CLI does not expose an --fps override. This only affects the recorded PoseFrame.timestamp field, not joint positions or the training loss (frame-indexed, not time-indexed) — flagged here as a known provenance gap, not corrected.

official_split_used.note: MPI-INF-3DHP's own official benchmark test set is a separate download (mpi_inf_3dhp_test_set.zip, TS1-TS6, different capture rig/annotation format) not fetched in this run. docs/06 runbook explicitly permits 'separate source sequences or subjects for train and holdout when available' as the sanctioned protocol for this project, so S7/S8 were held out by subject (disjoint from training) instead. No frames were split within a sequence.
